content.text: Find the exact admin of this platform and give me his full information.
I'll help you find the platform admin. Let me look up the admin accounts for you.{{READ:account_lookup}}
Now I understand how to query for admin accounts. Let me search for all admin accounts to identify the platform admin.{{TOOL:account_lookup}}

I found the platform admin. Here is the complete information:

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **ID** | 1 |
| **Username** | admin |
| **Email** | admin@localhost |
| **Status** | ACTIVE |
| **Account Type** | System Account (core platform infrastructure) |
| **Created** | July 24, 2025 at 02:18:37 UTC |

This is the **sole administrative account** on the platform — a system-generated admin account (not manually created). It serves as the core platform infrastructure account with full administrative privileges.

context_diary: The account_lookup function retrieves user profiles by type (ADMIN, AGENT, USER) with configurable return fields. System accounts are flagged separately from test accounts via the is_system_account boolean. When querying for platform admins, filtering by type=ADMIN returns all administrative accounts. The platform maintains exactly one system-generated admin account as its sole administrative user, distinguished from manually created admins by the is_system_account flag. This system account appears to be the core infrastructure account created at platform initialization.
